entities.name: NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transfer measurement results from UE to peer UE. Triggered for specific sl-MeasId and involves setting measurement results, managing reporting counters and timers.

entities.name: MeasurementReportSidelink
entities.description: Message used to transfer measurement results from UE to peer UE in sidelink communication.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Measurement identity that triggers the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure.

entities.name: sl-MeasResults
entities.description: Contains measurement results including sl-ResultDMRS for NR sidelink DMRS based quantities.

entities.name: sl-ResultDMRS
entities.description: NR sidelink DMRS based quantity indicated in sl-ReportQuantity within the concerned sl-ReportConfig.

entities.name: sl-NumberOfReportsSent
entities.description: Counter defined within VarMeasReportListSL that tracks number of reports sent for a sl-MeasId.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer used for periodical reporting with value set to sl-ReportInterval from sl-ReportConfig.

entities.name: sl-NumberOfReportsSent less than sl-ReportAmount
entities.description: Condition where number of reports sent is less than configured report amount, triggering timer start.

entities.name: sl-ReportType set to sl-Periodical
entities.description: Condition where report type is periodical, triggering cleanup of measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: Remove measurement entries from lists
entities.description: Property where UE removes entry from VarMeasReportListSL and sl-MeasId from sl-MeasIdList in VarMeasConfigSL.

relations.description: Procedure includes submitting MeasurementReportSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
MeasurementReportSidelink message contains sl-MeasResults information element.
sl-MeasResults contains sl-ResultDMRS for NR sidelink DMRS based quantities.
Procedure stops the periodical reporting timer if running.
When sl-NumberOfReportsSent is less than sl-ReportAmount, the periodical reporting timer is started.
When sl-ReportType is set to sl-Periodical, UE removes measurement entries from reporting lists.
Procedure includes incrementing sl-NumberOfReportsSent counter for the sl-MeasId.
